question.text: The frequencies at which the current amplitude in an LCR series circuit becomes <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt></mfrac></math> times its maximum value, are <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>212</mn><mo> </mo><mi>rad</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>232</mn><mo> </mo><mi>rad</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The value of resistance in the circuit is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math>. The self inductance in the circuit is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>mH</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Bandwidth of RLC circuit is BW=f2-f1=R2πL

Or, BW=ω2-ω1=RL

BW=232-212=RL

Thus, self inductance in the circuit is L=520=250 mH
